activity_summary.note: Merged from two sources: the Legistar Web API (historical, through 2023-06-21) and DataMade's Chicago Councilmatic mirror (current through 2026-07-15), which covers the period after Chicago's council left Legistar. Each record carries a `source`. recorded_votes appears only on the rare bills with a recorded roll-call split — most council actions pass by voice vote. sponsor_wards resolves only when a sponsor's name exactly matches a manually-filled entry in aldermen.json; empty means unresolved, not 'no sponsors'. topic_relevant/topic_reason are automated tags (topic_tag_tier: derived) — see topic_tagged_by ('llm' vs 'keyword_fallback').
